messages:
nina: FYI I opened a docs PR for an 'offline proxy + HSM audit checklist' aimed at Private/VPC installs. It bundles minimal firewall examples, PKCS#11 guidance, and a short audit/verification checklist. PTAL: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4999
doc-lead: Nice scope. Can we keep it intentionally short (one page) and include 1) nftables + iptables examples, 2) Windows netsh one-liner, 3) explicit PKCS#11 URI examples, and 4) a 5-step audit checklist for SREs?
ben: I'll add the firewall bits. Minimal nftables (ipv4 only) to accept 443 and loopback:
```
# nftables minimal
table ip filter {
  chain input { type filter hook input priority 0; ct state established,related accept; iifname "lo" accept; tcp dport 443 ct state new accept; }
}
```
iptables fallback: `iptables -A INPUT -p tcp --dport 443 -m conntrack --ctstate NEW,ESTABLISHED -j ACCEPT`

Also note sysctl net.ipv4.ip_forward=1 when routing.
ops-bot: CI for PR #4999  docs-linter: passed, linkcheck: found 1 moved anchor.
sec-team: Security asks: add a one-line mandatory verification directive: "Always verify GPG signatures and SHA256 checksums of offline artifacts before installing in air-gapped environments." Also mention non-exportable HSM keys and that proxies must use PKCS#11 engine integration. Keep each as 1-2 lines.
doc-lead: For PKCS#11 examples, include two URI patterns: `pkcs11:token=acme;object=bastion-key` and `pkcs11:slot-id=1;object=server-cert`. Add a short note: labels vs IDs vary by vendor.
nina: Good. Also customers asked for a tiny Windows netsh example to redirect 443->8080: `netsh interface portproxy add v4tov4 listenport=443 connectport=8080 listenaddress=0.0.0.0 connectaddress=127.0.0.1` plus firewall rule.
ben: Add a quick troubleshooting checklist (3 bullets): 1) tcpdump/tshark to confirm ClientHello SNI, 2) curl --resolve to force DNS to proxy, 3) check proxy TLS handshake logs for ALPN/handshake errors.
doc-lead: For the audit checklist (5 steps) propose: [1] verify offline artifact signatures and sha256 sums, [2] stage PKCS#11 provider RPM and confirm kernel module versions, [3] update proxy to reference PKCS11 URI and restart, [4] run TLS handshake smoke test (openssl s_client -connect localhost:443 -servername example.internal -showcerts), [5] document rollback steps (restore config + previous RPM). Keep wording terse.
sec-team: Also add a single line recommending to pin provider versions in the offline bundle and record the provider's GPG key fingerprint in the installation playbook.
nina: I'll update the PR with the nftables/iptables snippets, Windows netsh, PKCS#11 URIs, troubleshooting bullets, the 5-step audit checklist, and the signature pinning note. Pushed changes and fixed the moved anchor. Re-running CI.
ops-bot: CI for PR #4999  all checks passed :white_check_mark:
doc-lead: LGTM, merging. Thanks everyone — this should help customers and SREs run a fast, auditable install in sealed networks. :shipit:
